pay.demo.wallet: Demo mode: no payment provider is connected in this version, so cards are not checked with a bank and nothing is charged. Only the card brand, last four digits, expiry and name on the card are kept on this phone. The full number and security code are never saved or sent.
pay.demo.add: Demo mode: no bank is contacted and nothing is charged. Only the brand, last four digits, expiry and name are saved on this phone; the full number and security code are never saved or sent. Try a test card first.
pay.demo.checkout: Demo mode: card payment is simulated on this phone and nothing is charged. The payment is recorded as a demo payment.
